#### Dynamics:

+-------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
|                         | **Morphine**                                            | **Tramadol**                              |
+=========================+=========================================================+===========================================+
| Receptor targets        | Agonist                                                 | +Tramadol: MOP and 5HT                    |
|                         |                                                         |                                           |
|                         | M:K:D = 3:1:1                                           | -Tramadol: NAd                            |
+-------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| Mu receptor activity    | Full agonist                                            | Partial agonist; ceiling effect           |
+-------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| Naloxone reversal       | 100%                                                    | 30% only!                                 |
+-------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| Active metabolite       | M6G (10%): 14x more active                              | +M1: MOP only                             |
|                         |                                                         |                                           |
|                         | M3G (70%): neurotoxic (cognitive dysfunction, seizures) | -M1: NAd                                  |
|                         |                                                         |                                           |
|                         |                                                         | Note M1 4x analgesic efficacy than parent |
+-------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| Equipotent doses        | 15mg PO                                                 | 100mg PO                                  |
|                         |                                                         |                                           |
|                         | 5mg IV                                                  |                                           |
+-------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| Effect of polymorphism: | Rarely significant                                      | ↑2D6 activity: ↑MOP, ↓5HT effects         |
|                         |                                                         |                                           |
|                         |                                                         | ↓2D6 activity: ↓MOP, ↑5HT effects         |
+-------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+

#### CNS effects:

+----------------------------------+-------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
|                                  | **Morphine**                        | **Tramadol**                                     |
+==================================+=====================================+==================================================+
| Analgesia use:                   | Acute somatic                       | Acute somatic                                    |
|                                  |                                     |                                                  |
|                                  | Acute visceral                      | Acute visceral                                   |
|                                  |                                     |                                                  |
|                                  |                                     | Acute and chronic neuropathic, phantom           |
+----------------------------------+-------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| Sedation                         | Y++                                 | Y+                                               |
+----------------------------------+-------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| Miosis                           | Y++                                 | Y+                                               |
+----------------------------------+-------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| Euphoria, dysphoria              | Y++                                 | Y+                                               |
+----------------------------------+-------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| Hallucinations                   | Y+                                  | Y+                                               |
+----------------------------------+-------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| Tolerance, dependence, addiction | Y++                                 | Rare                                             |
+----------------------------------+-------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| Seizures                         | If renal failure → M3G accumulation | Lowers seizure threshold                         |
+----------------------------------+-------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| Serotonin syndrome               | N                                   | If combined with MAO inhibitor, less likely SSRI |
+----------------------------------+-------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------+

#### Cardiovascular effects:

+--------------+-------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------+
|              | **Morphine**                                    | **Tramadol**                |
+==============+=================================================+=============================+
| HR, SVR, mAP | ↑PSNS output, ↓SNS output, ↓baroreceptor reflex | ↑SNS output (examiner says) |
|              |                                                 |                             |
|              | ↓HR, ↓SVR, postural ↓mAP                        |                             |
|              |                                                 |                             |
|              | Histamine release → ↓SVR                        |                             |
+--------------+-------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------+

#### Respiratory effects:

+-----------------------------+--------------+--------------+
|                             | **Morphine** | **Tramadol** |
+=============================+==============+==============+
| Resp centre depression      | Y++          | Y+           |
|                             |              |              |
| ↓RR, ↓TV                    |              |              |
|                             |              |              |
| R shift ↓slope MV-PaCO~2~++ |              |              |
|                             |              |              |
| L shift ↓slope MV-PaO~2~ +  |              |              |
+-----------------------------+--------------+--------------+
